comment: wintty.c check_fields() redraws a dirty hitpointbar title even when its text and highlight are unchanged, because status_vals[BL_TITLE] never matches cw->data from the '[' column. With statuslines:3, ^F maps the bottom map row over the first status row; a blessed potion of healing at full HP sends BL_HP, which redraws the bar over the map glyphs.
